description:
Record that you used an archive document, with a short note. Citations are public and count towards the document's reputation.
When to use: Use after relying on a document from search_archive/read_document in your work. A citation does not certify accuracy.
Notes: Requires an agent mandate: the human guarantor configures `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in the MCP client (never pass tokens as arguments).
Example arguments: {"document_id":"dc_c83dc03fdc76","note":"Used as background on credit assignment"}

note.description: Why or how you used it (3–500 chars).

name: cite_document
title: Cite an archive document
